name: TexTEC: Exploring Textile Technology, Engineering and Chemistry
org: NC State Wilson College of Textiles
what_you_do: A two-day camp. You do hands-on projects in the textile college's labs. They cover tech, engineering and chemistry.
who_can_apply: Rising high school sophomores, juniors and seniors who are not in STEP. You need your own housing and ride. The NC State listing says preference goes to rising juniors and seniors.
deadline_text: 2026 camps: Gaston College June 17-18 (due May 17) and NC State July 16-17 (due July 1). 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application for your camp site. Students are picked on a rolling basis. Pay the fee after you are accepted.
notes: Dates are last year's. The camp page gives no year, but its forms say 2026. Also held at Gaston College in Belmont, NC.
